title: Entity and attribute map for one page
description: content-engine/entities/{slug}.json. A topic graph, not a keyword list: the value is in the typed relationships, which are what let a page explain a situation rather than mention terms. Every relationship carries its own evidence level — an unsupported one is a hypothesis, recorded as such.

relationships.description: Typed edges such as 'vehicle condition -> towing requirement'. Only recorded when supported by evidence or explicitly marked as a hypothesis.

observed_cooccurrence.description: Times the two entity types appear in one sentence in existing copy. Co-occurrence is evidence that a page connects two ideas; it is not evidence that the connection is true.

coverage_gaps.description: Entities the research says matter for this page that the existing copy never raises.
